children: The on-ground activation at V-Mart Kolkata-Esplanade brought home cooks and consumers together for a live culinary competition led by Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi

Borosil has partnered with V-Mart to bring Swaad Se Taaj Tak, an on-ground culinary experience, to Kolkata, turning the V-Mart Esplanade store into a live platform for cooking, competition and consumer engagement.

The activation brought together home cooks, food enthusiasts and customers for a live cook-off judged by celebrity chef Harpal Singh Sokhi. Participants showcased their culinary skills by preparing dishes in front of the chef, with the competition testing their creativity, technique and understanding of flavours.

Beyond judging the entries, Chef Harpal interacted with participants throughout the cook-off, observing their techniques, tasting their dishes and sharing culinary insights. His interaction with both contestants and customers added a participative element to the store experience.

The activation also gave Borosil an opportunity to demonstrate its cookware and kitchen solutions in a real cooking environment. Rather than presenting the products through a conventional retail display, consumers could see them being used during the live competition and experience their functionality in the context of everyday cooking.

Speaking at the event, Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi said, “It was wonderful to see the enthusiasm and creativity that the participants brought to the kitchen. Every home cook has a unique way of working with flavours and ingredients, and ‘Swaad Se Taaj Tak’ gave them a platform to bring that creativity to life. I thoroughly enjoyed interacting with the participants, tasting their dishes and sharing a few culinary tips along the way. It was great to see so many people come together to celebrate the joy of cooking.”

Barnali Shankar, VP – Marketing, Borosil, said, “At Borosil, we believe some of the strongest connections with consumers are built through experiences that are relevant to their everyday lives. ‘Swaad Se Taaj Tak’ allowed us to bring the joy of cooking to life in an engaging and participative format. Our association with V-Mart enabled consumers to experience Borosil’s cookware and kitchen solutions in a real cooking environment, while Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi’s presence brought tremendous energy to the initiative. We were delighted with the enthusiasm and participation we saw in Kolkata.”

The initiative reflects Borosil’s broader use of experiential and content-led formats to position its consumerware products within everyday lifestyle moments. Its Kitchen Connection property, for instance, has similarly used real kitchens and personalities to demonstrate how Borosil products fit into consumers’ daily lives.

With Swaad Se Taaj Tak, the brand has extended that approach into a physical retail environment, using live cooking and audience participation to create a more interactive product experience. For V-Mart, the association adds an experiential layer to the retail setting, bringing consumers together around food, entertainment and hands-on engagement.
